key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1018E
name: run_text_entry_input_loop
description: Polls the input event queue in a loop, appending printable characters to a text buffer of up to 14 characters, deleting on backspace and committing on return. It draws a vertical bar cursor at the insertion point and redraws the field through library calls on each change.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1020A
name: resume_text_entry_input_loop
description: Re-enters the same text entry loop at its key-handling step, using the current cursor position and buffer length. It handles backspace, return and printable characters, then redraws the field through library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1023E
name: clear_text_entry_then_poll
description: Resets the text entry length to zero, then runs the text entry input loop, which reads events, edits the buffer and redraws the field. It is the entry point used when a fresh field is needed.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10246
name: finish_text_entry_on_return
description: Handles the return key by terminating the current text buffer, then redraws the field and copies the completed text into the output string. Other keys fall through to the printable-character path that appends to the buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1028C
name: poll_text_entry_until_exit
description: Runs the text entry loop and returns once the current menu or field state reaches its exit value. Each pass reads an input event, updates the buffer and redraws the field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1028E
name: append_typed_character_and_poll
description: Appends the character of the current key event to the text buffer, capped at 14 characters. It then runs the text entry input loop, which reads events, edits the buffer and redraws the field.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:102C8
name: toggle_text_cursor_and_poll
description: Toggles the vertical bar cursor at the insertion point, swapping it with a space, and redraws that single glyph through a library call. It then continues the text entry input loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:102F6
name: draw_text_cursor_then_poll
description: Writes the vertical bar cursor into the buffer at the insertion point, redraws that glyph through a library call, and continues the text entry input loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10320
name: clear_entry_flag_and_poll
description: Clears the field's active flag and enters the text entry input loop, which keeps reading events and redrawing the field until a key ends it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10328
name: handle_slot_menu_selection
description: Handles a choice in an eight-entry list. It redraws the previously highlighted entry and the newly chosen one, then copies the chosen entry's stored text into the buffer; choosing the ninth position ends the menu.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1034E
name: store_text_entry_into_slot
description: Null-terminates the entered text and copies it into the selected record of a table of 48-byte entries, then redraws that entry's line through library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10390
name: poll_menu_input_events
description: Runs the menu input loop, reading key and mouse events, updating the highlighted entry and redrawing it through library calls until an exit event occurs.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10394
name: select_menu_slot_and_poll
description: Makes the entry at the current index the active one, copies its stored text into the buffer, redraws the highlight, and then runs the menu input loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:103DE
name: commit_entry_text_to_record
description: Clears the buffer terminator and, when the selected slot's length is nonzero, stores the typed text into that record and redraws its line through library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:103FC
name: load_slot_text_and_poll
description: Reads the slot index from the current record, copies that slot's stored text into the buffer, marks the entry active, and then runs the text entry input loop.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1042C
name: dispatch_text_entry_key_event
description: Dispatches one input event by its type. Backspace removes the last character, return commits the text, and other events fall through to the append and cursor routines, with the field redrawn through library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10462
name: confirm_slot_selection_and_poll
description: When the selected slot index is nonzero, redraws that slot's stored text and returns to the caller. Otherwise it runs the text entry input loop until a slot is chosen.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:104EC
name: forward_call_to_handler
description: Contains only a tail call to another routine and returns, so it does nothing beyond forwarding control to the handler.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:104F8
name: pad_text_and_return_length
description: Calls a library routine with a fixed mode argument, runs two helper routines, measures the resulting string, appends a trailing space after it, and returns the length.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10540
name: check_printable_ascii_character
description: Returns 1 when the given character code lies in the printable ASCII range from space to tilde, and 0 otherwise.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1055E
name: rebuild_compact_slot_table
description: Clears an eight-row table of 16-byte entries, then copies each non-empty 48-byte slot record into the rows in order. It stores each record's index in its row and saves the count of copied rows in a global.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1057E
name: rebuild_slot_table_from_frame
description: Rebuilds the same compacted slot table, taking the table and source pointers from the calling frame. It clears the eight rows, copies each non-empty record, and stores the count of copied rows.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1059A
name: copy_nonempty_slot_records
description: Copies each non-empty 48-byte slot record into consecutive 16-byte rows, storing the source record index in each row, and saves how many rows were copied.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:105F4
name: draw_slot_list_with_labels
description: Draws the slot selection screen with a heading and up to eight rows, showing each slot's name or a dashed marker for empty slots, plus a Load label, using library calls for text.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1074C
name: draw_fixed_panel_frame
description: Sets the drawing mode, fills a fixed-size rectangle at the origin, and draws a bordered box at a fixed position through library calls.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1079E
name: draw_three_menu_labels
description: Sets the drawing mode and draws three fixed text labels from the global string table. A fourth label is drawn when the flag argument is nonzero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10806
name: draw_cancel_done_buttons
description: Draws the dialog controls with Cancel and Done captions at fixed positions. An extra caption is drawn when the flag argument is nonzero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:108A2
name: draw_five_point_outline
description: Expands two coordinate pairs into a five-point outline on the stack, sets the drawing position, and calls a library drawing routine with that path.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1091A
name: open_display_window_or_fail
description: Asks the library to open a display window using a fixed structure, saves the returned handle in a global, and reports that a window could not be opened when the handle is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10948
name: stub_return_success
description: Returns 1 unconditionally with no other work, so it is a fixed success result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10966
name: close_display_window_if_open
description: When the window handle global is nonzero, closes that window through library calls, clears the handle, and then runs the follow-up routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1099C
name: load_block_with_fallback
description: Opens a named resource in a 32-byte local buffer. When the open succeeds it reads a fixed-size block into the destination and closes the resource; otherwise it issues a library call with a fallback flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:109D6
name: call_helper_and_return_success
description: Runs one setup helper and then a second helper with no arguments, and returns 1 to signal success.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:109F4
name: load_second_block_with_fallback
description: Runs a setup call first when a flag is zero, then opens a second resource and reads a fixed block into the destination if the open succeeds. It returns whether the resource was found.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10A26
name: call_two_helpers_return_success
description: Calls two helper routines with no arguments and returns 1.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10A44
name: initialise_save_name_buffer
description: Clears the first byte of a path buffer and writes the saves folder name into it, running an extra setup call first when the flag is zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10A90
name: initialise_request_block
description: Zeroes the leading fields of a 22-byte request block, sets its type byte, stores the two passed-in values, and calls a library routine with that block.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10AE4
name: install_serial_interrupt_handler
description: Sets up a serial interrupt handler through a library call, initialises two list pointers in the global block, and programs the serial period and interrupt enable registers.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10B26
name: send_serial_bytes_blocking
description: Transmits a counted run of bytes through the serial data register. Each byte has its stop bit set, and the routine waits for the transmit buffer empty flag before writing it.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10B4A
name: transmit_serial_bytes_sequence
description: Transmits a counted sequence of bytes through the serial data register, setting the stop bit on each and waiting for the transmit buffer to be empty before each write.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10B5E
name: stub_empty_routine
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10B66
name: read_serial_bytes_with_timeout
description: Reads a counted run of bytes from the serial receive ring buffer into the destination, waiting a short time for each byte through a timer library call. It returns zero when all bytes are read and minus one when a byte does not arrive in time.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10BB0
name: copy_serial_ring_buffer_bytes
description: Copies bytes out of the serial receive ring buffer into the destination, advancing the read index with wrap-around. It returns minus one when the buffer holds fewer bytes than requested.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10BDE
name: return_negative_one
description: Returns the constant minus one, which callers read as a failure result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10BE8
name: read_serial_bytes_with_wait
description: Reads a counted run of bytes from the serial receive buffer into a destination, waiting briefly for each byte through a timer library call. It returns zero on completion and minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEA
name: stub_return_zero
description: Returns zero and does nothing else.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10BEE
name: flush_serial_receive_buffer
description: Empties the serial receive ring buffer by setting its read index equal to its write index.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10BFC
name: count_pending_serial_bytes
description: Returns how many bytes are waiting in the serial receive ring buffer, accounting for wrap-around in a 128-byte buffer.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10C1E
name: compute_serial_buffer_distance
description: Computes the distance from the buffer's read index to a given position in the 128-byte ring buffer, adding the buffer size so the result stays positive.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10C36
name: disable_serial_receive_interrupt
description: Clears the serial receive interrupt enable bit in the interrupt enable register, then calls a library routine for the serial interrupt slot.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10C54
name: queue_serial_transmit_byte
description: Writes one byte into the serial transmit ring buffer at its write index, wrapping to the start of the buffer at its end, and sets a transfer status field to a fixed value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10C7E
name: send_message_with_checksum
description: Computes a two-digit checksum over the message text, sends the text and checksum through the serial output routine, then waits for a reply. On a receive timeout the message is cleared.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10CAC
name: send_checksummed_packet_retry
description: Sends a message and its checksum over the serial link, passing the message by stack reference, and retries the transmission while waiting for a reply code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10D08
name: parse_link_reply_packet
description: Reads up to four bytes of a link reply header and checks them against the expected reply code. An unexpected header or an overlong reply is shown as an error text, and a valid one returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10D2C
name: read_link_packet_or_conflict
description: Reads an incoming link packet header and, when the expected byte does not arrive or the packet is too long, shows the message saying the other side is sending at the same time and to try again.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10D4C
name: wait_link_reply_or_timeout
description: Reads up to four link reply bytes, retrying on timeouts and sending the reply code. If the expected reply does not arrive it shows the opponent not responding message.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10DBA
name: dispatch_link_packet_command
description: Parses an incoming link packet whose header marks its message class, verifies its checksum, and dispatches on its command byte to the matching handler.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10E42
name: verify_link_packet_checksum
description: Recomputes the checksum over a received packet and compares it with the received checksum bytes. It sends an acknowledge or rejection code and returns zero when the packet is valid.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10E72
name: receive_link_packet_with_retry
description: Sets a link state flag and repeatedly reads incoming serial data with retries and timeouts. It returns minus one when no further data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10E7A
name: send_link_handshake_and_wait
description: Sends one of two four-byte handshake codes, chosen by a host-side flag, then waits for incoming link data with retries and returns minus one if none arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10E88
name: send_link_sync_and_wait
description: Sends the four-byte synchronisation code over the link, then waits for a matching reply packet with retries and returns minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10EA2
name: return_zero_value
description: Returns a zero value without performing any work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10EAC
name: handle_link_command_code
description: Acts on a link command code. One code sends the matching four-byte acknowledgement and another sets a link flag, after which it waits for the next packet; any other code returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10EBA
name: receive_link_message_loop
description: Repeatedly waits for incoming link packets, handling each message class as it arrives, and returns minus one when the wait times out.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10EC6
name: receive_link_text_message
description: Sets the local link state flag and receives a text message from the link, ending it at the carriage-return marker. It returns minus one on timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10ED2
name: receive_link_line_with_timeout
description: Waits for a line of incoming link text, ending it at a carriage return, and returns minus one when no data arrives before the timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10EDA
name: read_modem_response_line
description: Reads a modem response line up to its end marker and shows it through a text routine, unless the line is an echo of the ATE command.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10F12
name: read_modem_reply_after_clear
description: Clears the reply byte, shows any received modem text unless it is an echo of the ATE command, and waits for the next modem response with a timeout.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10F4C
name: receive_link_packet_fields
description: Sets a link state flag and reads an incoming packet, checking its length field and copying the following bytes into a message buffer padded with blanks. It returns minus one when no data arrives.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10F62
name: send_link_status_if_active
description: When either of two link status fields equals two, builds a two-byte status packet with fixed marker bytes and sends it through the link output routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10FA6
name: send_link_type_two_packet
description: Builds a four-byte link packet with a fixed type and length byte, copies two bytes from the caller's structure into it, and sends it through the link output routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:10FEA
name: send_link_short_control_packet
description: Sends a fixed two-byte control packet with a type byte and a length of five through the link output routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:1101E
name: send_link_sync_and_clear
description: Sends the four-byte synchronisation code over the link and clears a link state flag.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:11040
name: fill_buffer_with_descending_bytes
description: Writes the low byte of a counter into each position of a buffer, counting down from the given length to zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:11054
name: next_pseudo_random_value
description: Advances the random seed by a library-supplied value plus a fixed constant, stores the new seed, and returns its upper bits masked to 15 bits.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit][a2]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit][a2].adf:BattleChess:0:11088
